scope.purpose: Define project information needed to support key decision gates, reliance boundaries, and downstream delivery planning.

requirements.statement: Reliance is permitted only when explicitly declared in a PIR.
Information delivered prior to the designated milestone gate shall be classified as Informational only.
Project Information Requirements shall be reviewed and baselined prior to the commencement of Detail Design.
Teams shall not rely on undocumented geometric assumptions for coordination decisions.

provenance.migration_note: Standalone L4 S2 production standard migrated as a candidate.
